title: Cognitive Function in Patients With Colorectal Cancer Who Do and Do Not Receive Chemotherapy: A Prospective, Longitudinal, Controlled Study
notes: Large prospective longitudinal controlled study comparing CRC patients (289 localized: 173 CTh+, 116 CTh-; 73 metastatic) to 72 healthy controls. Assessments at baseline, 6, 12, 24 months. Key finding: 43% CRC vs 15% HC cognitively impaired at baseline, persistent at 24mo. NO significant difference between chemotherapy and no-chemotherapy groups on objective cognitive function. Cytokines elevated in CRC vs HC but NOT associated with global cognitive function; ONLY processing speed domain showed cytokine association (IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12; rho=0.18-0.40). APOE E4 allele not associated with cognitive function. Low estradiol in women associated with cognitive impairment (rho=0.29, P<.001). Self-reported cognitive impairment higher in CTh+ at 6mo (32% vs 16%, P=.007) but not at 12mo. GDS method from HIV/Carey et al. for impairment classification.
effect_size_notes: Cytokine-processing speed correlations are Spearman rho, bivariate/unadjusted. Range rho=0.18-0.40 for IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, IL-12 individually with processing speed. Midpoint rho=0.29 used. SE calculated as sqrt((1-r^2)/(N-2)) with N=362. These are individual cytokine correlations used as proxy for composite OIC-processing speed association. Global cognition (GDS) showed NULL association with cytokines.

null_findings.cytokines_vs_global_cognition: No significant association between cytokine levels and global cognitive function (GDS or CANTAB GDS)
null_findings.chemotherapy_vs_cognition: No significant difference in cognitive impairment between CTh+ and CTh- groups at any timepoint
null_findings.APOE_vs_cognition: No association between E4 allele and any cognitive measure
null_findings.cytokines_vs_fatigue_anxiety_QOL: Fatigue, anxiety/depression, QOL not associated with objective neuropsychological performance (but associated with subjective cognitive symptoms)

cytokine_data.note: CRC patients had significantly higher levels of most cytokines vs HCs; CTh+ had highest (higher stage disease). Several cytokines remained elevated long-term without disease recurrence. Specific cytokine levels not reported in main text (in Data Supplement).

estradiol_data.note: In women only. Low estradiol associated with impairment. Not extracted as edge evidence because no SEX_HORMONES→COG edge in registry.
